sections.heading: Necessity Before Perfect Timing
sections.body: Electional timing is a weighting layer, not a reason to sabotage practical life. If a real-world opportunity has a deadline, choose the best workable moment inside the available window rather than waiting for an ideal chart that arrives too late. The app should never advise delaying urgent health, legal, safety, financial, or career action solely because the astrology is imperfect.

sections.heading: Mundane Factors First
sections.body: Astrological support must be weighed against ordinary conditions: preparedness, skill, timing in the human calendar, social context, access, money, safety, and the actual requirements of the task. A strong election cannot compensate for avoidable neglect of the non-astrological work.

sections.heading: Direct Current Rule
sections.body: The more directly a working calls on a planet, star, lunar mansion, planetary hour, or talismanic image, the more strongly the astronomical condition matters. A general reflective practice may tolerate rougher sky weather. A planetary talisman, planetary petition, or star-specific ritual should require tighter electional standards.

sections.heading: Minimum Electional Checks
sections.body: For any elected moment, check the Moon first, then the significator. Avoid a severely afflicted or void-of-course Moon for beginnings. Prefer the significator dignified, direct, visible, angular or succedent, unafflicted by the out-of-sect malefic, and supported by benefic testimony or reception. Place malefics away from the angles when the goal is constructive or protective.

sections.heading: Mitigation
sections.body: When timing is imperfect but action cannot wait, mitigate rather than pretend the chart is clean. Choose the least damaged window available, strengthen the relevant planet through dignity or planetary day/hour where possible, use benefic support, avoid direct contact with the harshest testimony, and keep the practical action modest, specific, and well-prepared.

sections.heading: Ethical Boundary
sections.body: Electional and ritual guidance must not encourage coercion, harm, dependency, medical avoidance, legal avoidance, or unsafe delay. For consumer apps, phrase electional guidance as supportive timing and reflective practice, not as a guarantee of control over another person or outcome.
